name: How do I choose between tile, marble, and quartz surfaces in the kitchen?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose between tile, marble, and quartz surfaces in the kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing between tile, marble, or quartz comes down to maintenance habits, budget, and desired aesthetics. Porcelain or ceramic tile is budget-friendly, highly heat resistant, and easy to replace in individual sections. Marble offers timeless natural veining and luxury appeal, but it is porous, requires periodic sealing, and can etch from acidic foods like lemon juice or tomato sauce. Engineered quartz provides non-porous durability without routine sealing, making it exceptionally stain resistant for busy households. Balancing these tradeoffs helps you match surfaces to your cooking routine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Quartz offers non-porous, low-maintenance durability, while marble delivers natural beauty but requires sealing, and tile provides budget-friendly flexibility.
